deviations.what: The credits page keeps the title 'Credits', not 'Credits and licences'.
deviations.why: P1-A4's pages.spec.ts reads the h1 'Credits', and I may not edit that test.

deviations.what: history and confusions carry no draft: true.
deviations.why: The strict pages schema has no draft field, and the schema is not mine to change.

deviations.what: The code licence shown is AGPL-3.0-only.
deviations.why: This is the owner's licence, read from the root package.json. It is never typed.

deviations.what: data-commit holds the build's short commit, for example 11f0419.
deviations.why: astro.config.mjs (P1-A2/MERGE) sets PUBLIC_GIT_COMMIT from git rev-parse --short HEAD. The test accepts HEAD, a prefix of HEAD, an ancestor of HEAD, or 'unknown'.

deviations.what: The lines that read the licences exist twice, once in Footer.astro and once in credits.mdx, reading the same two files.
deviations.why: A shared module would be a new file outside my ownership. The test checks that both match the files.

deviations.what: The confusions page says the two moves are different matrices 'at every node joined to another'.
deviations.why: At an isolated node S_i equals R_i. The owner holds this wording; the sentence is recorded in my decisions fragment.
